lernapps.github.io.reason: Three clean-up commits directly one after the other on the branch of pull request #17.
lernapps.github.io.message:
chore: no forwards and no legacy mentions on the home page

## Intent

Start clean. Nothing needs to stay compatible yet, so forwards of old addresses, mentions of the map and of the earlier edugo idea, and the old domain lernapps.github.io go away in every repo.

## Key changes

- 404.html is a plain not-found page instead of a script that forwards the Mathe-Karte's old root paths; llms.txt no longer explains the move.
- /map/ is no longer treated as a path of another repo.
- The README, the UnoCSS config, the privacy notice and the start page no longer mention edugo, the map or lernapps.github.io; the README has no history section.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The same clean-up in lernapps.github.io (127d4fa, c714fba, 99e1a16), docs (3c41d23), apps (b60a22f), tooling (53a4f1a) and app-templates (a075a7b).

## Intent

- The 404 page no longer forwards old Mathe-Karte paths.

- All addresses use lernapps.net instead of lernapps.github.io.
